title: Hands to the Sky
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A jubilant piano-house rave that builds from a bare 909 pulse into cascading piano stabs and a euphoric drop, with UK garage shuffle hats and a driving acid bassline that breathes and surges throughout. From intimate intro to full-room euphoria, the track earns every peak before stripping back to a warm, glowing close.
